text:
jenna-oncall: Heads up — getting a flood of admission-control alerts for the eu1 hosted GPU pool right now, started ~00:12 UTC. p95 queueing creeping up and customers are seeing increased latencies.
capacity-bot: ALERT eu1_gpu_pool_admission: throttle_rate=0.31 duration=7m shards=3
sam-enginfra: noticing a lot of 50–300 token requests landing at the same time. small seq len but high concurrency.
maria-sre: dashboard: p95_queue_ms=4200 p99_queue_ms=11800 admission_retries=0.9% error_budget_consumed=12% — spike started at 00:10
oliver-platform: routing config currently pins model variants to exact hashes; fallback to eu2 is configured but won't trigger because of pinning.
jenna-oncall: can we relax variant pinning as a quick mitigation? we can force compatible variant routing for 15m.
sam-enginfra: yes — I can toggle the pin rule for hosted-eu1 pools. quick note: kvcache warms slowly after a fallback; short-term latency might increase.
maria-sre: tradeoff accepted for now. we need to avoid full admission stall though.
jenna-oncall: @nina-capacity please confirm whether we have spare burst GPUs in eu2 or other regions.
nina-capacity: eu2 has ~18% spare capacity but cross-region network egress and compliance flags may affect some customer flows. we can shift non-regulated traffic.
oliver-platform: also noticing proxy connection churn to eu1 endpoints, some 502s correlated with admission spikes. possible nginx timeouts.
sam-enginfra: sharing a quick query to inspect admission throttle by pool:
```
sum(rate(admission_throttle_total{region="eu1"}[5m])) by (pool)
```
jenna-oncall: thanks. executing now — pool:hosted-eu1-a shows highest rate.
maria-sre: suggestion: enable short-lived grace routing to eu2 for model families: open-* excluding customer-pinned models. I can prepare a canary rule.
oliver-platform: i'll add a canary rule for 5% of traffic -> eu2 for open-7b/13b families, TTL 10m.
jenna-oncall: please also flip admission backoff to be slightly more aggressive to free headroom (reduce max_wait_ms from 12000 -> 8000) — that should shed queued requests faster.
sam-enginfra: done — backoff param adjusted on admission-controller in eu1, will propagate in ~30s.
capacity-bot: INFO config_change: admission_backoff.max_wait_ms updated from 12000 to 8000 by sam-enginfra
maria-sre: I'm watching p95/p99 now. initial dip at 00:22 but p99 still high due to a handful of long tail KV cache misses.
jenna-oncall: if canary reduces pressure we keep it, else rollback. also need an action to check autoscaler cooldown — it didn't bring extra nodes during the first 10m of the spike.
sam-enginfra: filed infra task: infra-2207 — investigate autoscaler cooldown and GPU pool refill timing.
oliver-platform: noted a side effect: switching variants for some customers will increase token counts and costs. tagging @finance-ops to flag for postmortem cost impact.
finance-ops: acknowledged — please include rough delta estimate and affected customer subset.
nina-capacity: suggest standby: if spike sustains >20m, we'll start an emergency refill for one rack in eu1, ETA 12–18m to be available to admission engine.
jenna-oncall: agree. if canary + backoff doesn't bring sustained p95 < 2s in 10m we'll start refill.
maria-sre: can we add a short dashboard panel showing admission throttles by model family? helps root cause.
sam-enginfra: added temp panel under "eu1 incident" dashboard.
capacity-bot: ALERT CLEARED eu1_gpu_pool_admission: throttle_rate dropped to 0.07
jenna-oncall: good — p95 now ~1.4s, p99 ~3.2s. keeping canary for 20m then roll-down.
oliver-platform: rolling canary down to 2% now to observe reversion effects.
maria-sre: leaving runbook note: potential causes — bursty PLG onboarding, poorly cached prefixes from a recent deploy, or client retry storms. follow-up: attach sample traces.
jenna-oncall: thanks all. postmortem owners: sam-enginfra (infra cause), maria-sre (SLO impact & runbook), oliver-platform (routing change). nina-capacity will do capacity follow-up and cost impact with finance-ops.
finance-ops: will prepare cost delta estimate; include any cross-region egress numbers.
jenna-oncall: closing thread when postmortem PR is open. :thumbsup:
